mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and aminoglycosides like tobramycin have increased nephrotoxicity risk when combined with beta-lactams; additive renal toxicity can occur, particularly with prolonged use or in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider dosage adjustments based on renal status; use combination only when clinically necessary.
